facts.business: Manaksia Limited is an Indian industrial enterprise with manufacturing operations in Nigeria through its subsidiaries, producing galvanized steel, pre-painted aluminium coils and sheets, roofing products, metal packaging, paper packaging, and non-ferrous alloys for the automotive industry.

capacity_or_capex.item: Zinc Aluminium Alloy coating line project
capacity_or_capex.timeline: commissioning in the last quarter of CY 2026

key_risks: Revenue concentration risk with two customers contributing over 10% of total revenue
Execution risk of proposed demerger of Metal Product business into Manaksia Ferro Industries Limited pending NCLT approval
Mark-to-market losses on investments leading to significant decline in Return on Investment
Decreasing inventory turnover and trade receivables turnover ratios indicating working capital pressure
facts.related_party_note: Proposed demerger of Metal Product business undertaking conducted through domestic entities into Manaksia Ferro Industries Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary, under Scheme of Arrangement approved by Board on March 26, 2025, and filed with NCLT.
